domain.text: Tooling and test-fixture isolation for vmethod’s Mermaid and jsdom dependencies.

impressions.text: The work isolated test consumers outside the repository and added Mermaid 12.1.0 with jsdom support from version 24, including tests across jsdom 24 and 27.
The worker reported all listed validation checks passing, including 185 tests, and the orchestrator independently verified the local check and offline tests.
The self-check reported only the allowed missing owner-installed settings file; no other review catches, stops, or escalations are stated.
